title: Saratoga Springs celebrates two state champions - NewsBreak
text: SARATOGA SPRINGS, NY ( NEWS10 ) — The City of Saratoga Springs celebrated both of its state baseball champions on Wednesday night with a parade and proclamation from the mayor. Both the Saratoga Springs and Saratoga Central Catholic Varsity baseball teams took home state titles earlier in the month. June 14th proved to be a historic day for both programs, when the Blue Streaks won the Class AAA state crown and the Saints won the Class C title game, both programs securing their first championship in history. The celebration on Wednesday was a special way to end the historic season for both squads. “It means a lot, still trying to take it all in,” said Saratoga Springs Senior, Adam Weiss. “I’m very excited to be a part of this and to do it for my city.” The streets were filled with supporters for both squads. Baseball fans in Saratoga cheered throughout the parade and proclamation ceremony. The community support meant a lot to the players. “All the people who came to support us in Saratoga, it really shows how well we are as a community,” said Saratoga Central Catholic Senior, Hunter Fales. One state championship for a city is impressive, for two teams from the same place to win is special. Both teams making a run at the title at the same time was special for the players as well. “It’s awesome, it’s great for our community,” said Fales. “It brings us together, I have some friends on that team, I’m just really happy for them. We were watching them play while we were getting ready to play our game. Seeing them win motivated us.” For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to NEWS10 ABC.
